stdio_review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: Build the undirected hearing graph with squared distance <=2500 and initial speakers within squared distance 100 of the door. All utterance starts lie on multiples of X. If Y>=X, a vertex cannot repeat two rounds after its first speech, so the wave visits every reachable vertex exactly once at its multi-source BFS distance: any first repeated vertex would be two rounds after its first visit because neighboring BFS levels differ by at most one, and cooldown forbids that. If Y<X only the immediately preceding round is blocked; any edge from a speaking vertex to a non-speaker propagates forever, since its two endpoints guarantee a boundary edge at each subsequent round. Thus either the initial set has such an edge (infinite), or all speech ends after X. No initial speakers gives zero.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
